name: Create and send a client invoice in Stripe Invoicing
goal: From Stripe Dashboard Invoicing, create a native invoice: add/select customer, add line items with quantities and amounts, optionally tax/coupons, then review and send without third-party invoice plugins.

source.title: How To Send Invoices with Stripe for Beginners | Stripe Invoicing Tutorial 2021

constraints: Operational freelancing/product procedure only — no get-rich-quick claims.
Ground every step in YouTube-provided captions; adapt UI labels if the product renamed menus.
Tax/VAT UI path only — not tax advice.

steps.action: Dashboard → Invoicing (under More if needed) → Create invoice.
Select existing customer or Add new customer (name+email) → Save.
Add one-time line items (description, qty, amount); add additional items as needed.
Optionally attach tax rates or coupons if configured; save.
Review preview → Send invoice; confirm it appears in Invoices list.

verification: Payment link works in intended mode
